locator.text: Equation (8.8), p. 90, in the statement of Lemma 8.2

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The rewriting is β := α + p κ_s. Lean states the conclusion as membership in every class — `∀ β : ℝ, MeanClass … β (A f)` — rather than as the explicit rate ε^{α+pκ_s}; unfolding MeanClass (see eq-p090-5) at β = α + p κ_s gives exactly |∂^I A_e f| ≤ C ε^{α+pκ_s} S_*^{B} ζ δ^{-B} with one constant and one degree per finite derivative order, i.e. the paper's display with C_{j,I,p}, B_{j,I,p}. Conversely the paper's family over all integers p ≥ 1 gives every real β, because ε ≤ 1 makes the classes decrease in the exponent (MemClass.mono_exponent, WeightedClasses.lean:191) and α + p κ_s → ∞. The constants match: ChartScales.kappa = 1/100000 (ChartScales.lean:24) is the paper's κ_s = 10^{-5}; ε = ChartScales.epsilon h n = Q n ^ h (line 29) is the paper's ε = Q^h; the frequency is M = radialCoefficient h n = Λ^{i_0} Q^{d_r/2} (line 33) with radialExponent h = 2((1+h)ρ − hκ) (line 25), the paper's d_r = 2((1+h)ρ_g − hκ_s), and the one gain ε^{κ_s} per integration by parts enters through actual_inverse_frequency_bound (|M|⁻¹ ≤ B ε^{κ_s} S^q, GaugeAliasDecay.lean:429). The hypothesis matches too: PressureStream.pressureMass f s = ∫ r, torusAverage f (r,s) (PressureStream.lean:121) is ∫ R^0 ⟨f⟩_Y dR, the paper's condition at e = 0; the e = 1 case is meanClass_dividedAlias_superflat applied to PressureStream.weightedSource f = R·f, whose zero mass is ∫ R ⟨f⟩_Y dR = 0. Lean adds hypotheses the paper carries implicitly from §6 (periodicity in Y, support in the active shell, and nativeIndex h n ≤ index n + D, a lower bound on the common torus index i_0). As with (8.7) no e = 2 instance was found, which is harmless here: the only place the paper applies (8.7)–(8.8) at e = 2, Corollary 8.5, has a Y-independent source whose remainder A_2 is identically zero rather than merely flat.
